drhp.business: CleanMax is a business-to-business renewable energy provider serving only commercial and industrial (C&I) customers, with 2.80 GW of operational, owned and managed capacity and 3.17 GW contracted-yet-to-be-executed as of October 31, 2025. It supplies renewable power under long-term PPAs/EAPAs and offers EPC, O&M and carbon-credit services across solar, wind and hybrid plants (Onsite within customer premises and Offsite in CleanMax-developed farms). Inception 2010; ~15 years of operating history.
drhp.co: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited
drhp.end_markets: Data centres, AI and technology customers (Amazon, Apple, Cisco, Equinix, Google)|Conventional C&I: infrastructure, cement, steel, industrial manufacturing, FMCG, pharmaceuticals, real estate, global capability centres

market_size.metric: Cumulative corporate open-access RE capacity (incl. rooftop)

sk.overview: The Indian corporate/C&I renewable power market covers solar, wind and wind-solar-hybrid power procured by commercial and industrial consumers via open-access, group-captive, third-party PPAs and increasingly virtual PPAs (VPPAs/EAPAs) and energy-attribute certificates (I-RECs). C&I consumers account for over 50% of India's power market; renewable energy offers 30-45% cost savings over grid tariffs, driving substitution of grid power with bilaterally-procured renewables under a supportive open-access regulatory regime.
sk.schemes: Green Energy Open Access Rules 2022|National Green Hydrogen Mission|PM-KUSUM Scheme|Pradhan Mantri Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana|PLI Scheme (solar PV modules, batteries)|Ultra Mega Renewable Energy Parks|500 GW non-fossil capacity by 2030 target / India NDCs
sk.structure: C&I renewable procurement via onsite solar, offsite STU-connected (group captive / third-party open access), CTU/ISTS-connected, and virtual PPAs (VPPA/EAPA with I-RECs). Distinct from utility-scale developers who bid lowest-tariff tenders to state discoms; C&I model is customer-specific …
